hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' | { read -r cmd; if echo "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'sudo[[:space:]]+chmod'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: sudo chmod broke macOS TCC filesystem access for Claude Code in this repo before and required a session restart (see CLAUDE.md). Do not run sudo chmod here."}}'; fi; }

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */content/quizzes/*.json) if ! jq -e 'type=="object" and has("lessonId") and has("questions") and (.questions|type=="array")' "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; then jq -n --arg f "$f" '{decision:"block", reason: ("Invalid quiz JSON in " + $f + " \u2014 must be {lessonId, questions:[...]}, not a bare array. A bare array causes a silent Vue render failure that empties the lesson content div.")}'; fi ;; esac; }
